name: Broadcasting
tagline: Tell stories through video, audio, and live production.
description: The Broadcasting pathway teaches students to plan, shoot, edit, and deliver video and audio content, from news packages to live broadcasts. Students work hands-on with cameras, editing software, and studio equipment used in real television and streaming production.

courses.title: Intro to Digital Technology
courses.desc: Foundational course covering digital media tools and concepts.

courses.title: Digital Media: Audio & Video Production I
courses.desc: Camera operation, audio capture, and non-linear editing basics.

courses.title: Digital Media: Audio & Video Production II — Broadcast
courses.desc: Studio production, live broadcast workflow, and advanced editing.
prerequisites: Digital Media: Audio & Video Production I

courses.title: Advanced Broadcast Production
courses.desc: Independent and small-group broadcast projects at an advanced level.
prerequisites: Digital Media: Audio & Video Production II — Broadcast

courses.title: Work-Based Learning
courses.desc: Paid or unpaid placement with a local media/broadcast employer.
prerequisites: Digital Media: Audio & Video Production II — Broadcast
